assertions.subject: Hibernoma
assertions.quote: Lipoma-like variants of hibernomas can resemble lipomas on imaging and histopathology, owning to their higher composition of white fat cells.

assertions.subject: Hibernoma
assertions.quote: When small, hibernomas can resemble other capillary-rich neoplasms, including hemangiomas and angiolipomas.

assertions.subject: Hibernoma
assertions.quote: Hibernomas can be warm to touch on physical exam, and as such, an abscess can be considered in the differential diagnosis.

assertions.subject: Hibernoma
assertions.quote: Fibromatosis can be considered in the differential, although imaging can distinguish between these two entities.

assertions.subject: Liposarcoma
assertions.quote: On imaging, a liposarcoma can be difficult to distinguish from hibernomas.

assertions.subject: Hypervascular Hibernoma
assertions.quote: On rare occasions, hypervascular hibernomas can also resemble lymphoma on CT imaging.

assertions.subject: Cutaneous Metastasis of Breast Carcinoma
assertions.quote: Cutaneous and subcutaneous metastasis often originate from melanoma, breast cancer, colorectal cancer, renal cell carcinoma, and lung cancer.
